title: US grid forecast checks: accuracy of published electricity demand forecasts
description: Reproducible checks of United States electricity demand forecasts on public data: a timing audit of every balancing authority's day-ahead forecast in Form EIA-930, a test-year score of a simple model against five operators' own forecasts, PJM, NYISO and ISO New England long-term forecasts against the peaks that followed, the value of one point of PJM forecast error, and a results page. Temperature data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY 4.0.
